## Solution

<details>
<summary><b>C++</b> (spoiler) · <code>0136-single-number.cpp</code></summary>

```cpp
class Solution {
public:
    int singleNumber(vector<int>& nums) {
        int output = 0;
        for (int x: nums){
            output = x ^ output;
        }
        return output;
    }
};
```

</details>
